_description: L3-D2 role 'Environment template' (lanes/L3-06-tasks.md L3-D2 table; contracts_map.py CONTRACTS key environment_template). The DECLARED side of Section 53.1 rows 7 and 8 (CMP-07 environments, CMP-08 deployment branch/tag policy). Section 33.4: 'Every environment carries a deployment branch and tag policy, applied from the template at product creation' - this is that template. Section 11.3: a repository with branch protection and no such policy 'holds production credentials behind nothing.' Section 11.4 is binding on what is deliberately NOT here: environment required reviewers and wait timers are a GitHub Enterprise-only feature and are not declared here; production approval and self-review prevention are enforced by the Section 27.2 workflow-identity gate instead. Do not add a required_reviewers key: declaring a control the plan cannot apply produces permanent, unfixable drift. Content carried forward from the prior design draft at lanes/L3-01-diff-engine.md task L3-01-10 (superseded reference; relocated from tools/provision/templates/environment.yaml to this contracts/reconciler/ path per the same FD-045 layout-alignment note as the branch-protection template).
